description: Recall quality under the 8-fact/512-token budget. Quality queries carry relevance judgments (recall@5); the budget query has ten relevant facts sized so the 8-fact cap binds before the token cap (each ~45 tokens), and checks both caps. Every returned URI must resolve through the SDK.

facts.text: Orbit's search service is written in Go and deployed on Kubernetes.
The Orbit search index rebuilds every night at 01:00 UTC.
Mara is the on-call lead for Orbit search this quarter.
Orbit billing invoices are generated on the first business day of the month.
Billing disputes for Orbit go to the finance mailbox, not to support.
The Orbit billing service stores amounts in minor units (cents).
Orbit's mobile app targets iOS 17 and Android 14 as minimum versions.
The Orbit mobile team ships a release train every two weeks.
Orbit dashboards are built with Grafana and read from Prometheus.
Alert thresholds for Orbit latency are p95 over 800 milliseconds for five minutes.
Orbit customer data lives in the eu-west-1 region only.
Orbit backups are encrypted with a per-tenant KMS key.
Jonas maintains the Orbit Terraform modules.
Orbit design reviews happen on Thursdays at 15:00 CET.
The Orbit style guide forbids default exports in TypeScript.
Orbit pull requests need one approving review and a green CI run.
Orbit retry policy, rule 1 of 10: the queue worker retries a failed job with exponential backoff starting at 1 seconds and parks it in the dead-letter queue after 3 attempts.
